GRAPHICS

Touch: joystick moves · up = jump · down = block · P punch · K kick · H heavy · SP special · SUPER when the meter is full · DASH.

Keyboard (1 player): A/D or ←/→ move · W/↑/Space jump · S/↓ block · J punch · K kick · L heavy · I special · O super · U dash.

2 players: P1 = A D W S + F G H T Y, dash R · P2 = arrows + J K L I O, dash U.

Combos: Punch → Punch → Kick → Heavy → Special → SUPER. Double-tap a direction to dash.
